title: Text-to-SQL: An Analytics Copilot on Trap-Laden Data
summary: An analytics copilot answering business questions in SQL, measured on a goldset whose data hides the business rules a schema cannot show.
metrics: With the glossary, Haiku 4.5 rises from 58 % to 86 % correct and Sonnet 5.5 from 91 % to 96 %.
Haiku 4.5 with glossary: 9.85 USD per 1000 correct answers, the cheapest combination.

demo.note: Gallery of all measured runs is open; live questions need an access code.
